newsitem.title: USA: U.S. STOCKPILE SELLS 220 TONNES OF SPOT TIN.
newsitem.headline: U.S. STOCKPILE SELLS 220 TONNES OF SPOT TIN.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center sold 220 tonnes of tin at an average price of $5,570.74 a tonne, or $2.5269 a lb, the agnecy announced.
The highest winning bid was Rotometals Inc., which bid $2.5475 a pound for 10 tonnes. The lowest winning bid was RMT Metals, which bid $2.5225 a lb.
Allied Deals bought a 25-tonne lot for $2.5330 a pound, and a 75-tonne lot for $2.5225 a lb.
F&S International bought 20 tonnes at $2.53 a lb.
Baron Metals bought a 30-tonne lot at $2.5265 and a 10-tonne lot at $2.5245 a lb.
RMT bought another 30-tonne lot at $2.5275 a lb.
The London Metal Exchange closing cash price was $2.52 a pound Wednesday, the day the bids were opened.
The Stockpile yielded $1,225,564.72 in the sale.
